segments.subtask: The robot arm is positioned above the white bowl, preparing to interact with it.
The robot arm moves closer to the white bowl, positioning its gripper over the spoon.
The robot arm grasps the spoon inside the white bowl.
The robot arm lifts the spoon from the white bowl, holding it above the green bowl.
The robot arm moves the spoon over the green bowl, preparing to pour its contents.
The robot arm tilts the spoon, pouring its contents into the green bowl.
The robot arm returns the spoon to the white bowl after pouring.
The robot arm lifts the spoon again from the white bowl for the second time.
The robot arm moves the spoon over the green bowl for the second time.
The robot arm tilts the spoon, pouring its contents into the green bowl again.
